LESSON: WRITING 5.5.1 THE WRITING PROCESS

Grade: SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10
Subject: ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.5: Writing 5.5.1 The Writing Process
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 4

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 5.5.1 The Writing Process, part of Strand 5 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 10 ENGLISH FOR LEARNERS WITH VISUAL IMPAIRMENT JUNE.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to follow the writing process?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Writing 5.5.1 The Writing Process together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
Learning to learn: The learner prioritises tasks as they search online or in books for the process of writing and display the

information in class.

Values:
● Unity: The learner displays team spirit as they share in groups previous writing experiences.

● Respect: The learner appreciates diverse opinions as they report their experiences to the whole class.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs):

Life skills- self-awareness: The learner is able to cope with stress as they report their experiences to the whole class.

Suggested Learning Resources

● Print texts

● Braille texts

● Electronic reading materials

● Digital devices with assistive technology

● Audio visual clips
